landing.headline: See how your leadership team really works.
landing.lead: A research-based reading of your team in minutes. Invite your group to one shared, anonymous picture, then improve it meeting by meeting.

sample.label: Sample team view

signIn.heading: Sign in
signIn.lead: We email you a link to sign in. It works once, for 15 minutes. No password.

save.lead: Sign in by email to make your group and get its one link.

newGroup.submit: Make the group and get the link
